annotations.text: Density comes from Premiere: 26px panel headers, 1px black seams between panels, 2-3px radii, no gradients. The accent appears once per screen.
Suggestions follow Opus Clip: thumbnail first, score as the only saturated element, reason underneath. The dock adds a transcript so you can read while you trim.
Clips carry filmstrip over waveform with the name floated on top. Track headers use bare glyphs, no button chrome, and colour follows the source media type.
